explication: spdlog is a C++ logging library. The main workflow is an application logging call, level filtering and message formatting, then synchronous delivery to one or more sinks; async loggers dispatch messages through a worker pool first. The graph also shows registry/configuration, backtrace buffering, periodic flushing, and representative output targets. The README documents additional sinks and formatting features; their wiring is not fully visible in the sampled source, so uncertain internal links are omitted.
